intro: Today's briefing explores the intersection of AI policy, corporate influence, and infrastructure development. OpenAI unveils a new biodefense framework while major tech companies face shifts in political alignment and environmental scrutiny.

must_know.title: Biodefense in the Intelligence Age
must_know.summary: OpenAI has published a five-part action plan focused on enhancing cybersecurity and biological resilience against AI-related threats. The initiative emphasizes democratizing defensive AI tools and hardening critical infrastructure systems.
must_know.why_it_matters: As AI capabilities grow, establishing proactive defense frameworks for biological and cyber security is becoming a primary focus for major AI labs.

must_know.title: Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump’s attempt to rename AI
must_know.summary: Several Silicon Valley leaders have begun adopting the Trump administration's terminology of "super intelligence" in place of "artificial intelligence." While the general public maintains usage of the original term, influential industry figures are shifting their branding to align with official policy.
must_know.why_it_matters: The shift highlights how political discourse can influence corporate branding and nomenclature in the technology sector.

must_know.title: Google is illegaly cutting forest to build data centers
must_know.summary: Google has faced temporary halts on data center projects in Finland due to environmental impact concerns involving land use and forestry.
must_know.why_it_matters: Environmental regulatory hurdles are increasingly challenging the global deployment of hyperscale data centers.
